versions.changelog:
- Initial release of video-ad-creation skill for Remotion video ads
- Guides users to produce 15s, 30s, or 60s ad videos with structured scene-based storytelling (hook, value, CTA, etc.)
- Provides step-by-step workflow: ad format selection, scene planning, React component structure, Remotion composition registration, and rendering commands
- Specifies required input from users: ad duration, product, key message, brand assets, and target platform
- Includes sample code snippets for scene components and timeline sequencing
- Outlines integration points with related skills for Remotion best practices and social video formats
